['Gerresheimer AG '].company_description: Gerresheimer AG (formerly Gerresheimer Glass AG) is a German manufacturer of primary packaging products for medication and drug delivery devices made of special-purpose glass and plastics with headquarters in Düsseldorf for the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries. The company has production operations in Europe, the Americas and Asia.

['T\u00dcV Nord AG '].company_description: TÜV Nord AG operates as an internationally active, independent service company from Germany and Austria that tests, inspects, and certifies technical systems, facilities, and objects of all kinds in order to minimize hazards and prevent damages. The company is organized into three large holding companies, TÜV Nord, TÜV Rheinland, and TÜV SÜD, along with smaller independent companies TÜV Thüringen, TÜV Saarland, and TÜV Austria.
